_doc: Template registry for fleet_bus v2 instructions. An instruction of the form {"template": "<id>", "args": {...}} is accepted only when <id> is listed here and every arg is a number, bool, null or an id-shaped string (no whitespace, so no free text). Add your own ids; the description is for humans.

answer_query.description: Answer a question from your own ground truth. args: topic

review_artifact.description: Review a file and report findings. args: path

status_report.description: Report the current status of a task. args: task_id

run_skill.description: Run a named skill on a named input. args: skill, input
